title: Function Selector Drift Detective & Arg Schema Linter
creator: Arjun Mehta
description:
Problem: Were seeing intermittent drops in correct function/tool selection after model and config rollouts. Existing canary signals catch high-level correctness regressions but miss subtle selection drift and malformed argument outputs that only show up on realistic cascades (tool -> external api).

Goal: Build a lightweight, continuous eval prober that measures (1) function/tool selection accuracy against a golden labeled set, (2) argument schema validity against a signed JSON schema registry, and (3) drift signals tied to model/config changes so we can alert and optionally auto-fallback. This will be used as a fast feedback loop for runtime/model rollouts and as an input to the regression scoreboard used by PM/Eng.

Scope:
- A standalone harness service that runs synthetic and sampled live requests through the same routing layer used in production (respecting routing policies).
- Golden dataset with per-query expected tool and canonical argument examples; allow versioned updates and provenance.
- Argument schema linter that validates both types and domain constraints (e.g., id formats, price ranges) and surfaces where models produce structurally valid but semantically invalid args.
- Per-commit and per-deployment delta scoring; thresholds configurable per-workload.
- Dashboard with selection-accuracy, schema-fail-rate, and change-point markers tied to releases and config diffs.
- Alerting rules that notify on sustained degradation and optionally trigger an automated rollback/fallback to a pinned model variant or the previous routing policy.
acceptance_criteria: Harness runs nightly and on deploy, ingesting both synthetic test cases and sampled production requests (sampling config configurable)
Selection accuracy metric computed per-model and per-routing-policy; baseline and delta scoring stored in timeseries (Influx/Grafana or Datadog)
Argument schema registry implemented as versioned JSON Schemas with signed provenance; linter rejects invalid payloads and reports field-level failure reasons
Dashboard shows selection-accuracy, schema-fail-rate, and top failing intents; change points annotated with deploy/config diff links
Alerting rules fire when selection accuracy drops >5% absolute or schema-fail-rate increases >3% for 30min across top-10 intents
End-to-end test with injected regression (small model tweak) demonstrates alert and rollback to pinned model variant
Documentation page covering how to add new test cases, update schemas, and interpret alerts
test_plan_steps: Create 250 golden cases across common intents with expected tool and sample args
Wire harness to routing layer in a canary namespace and run 3 full sweep runs (synthetic only) and record baseline scores
Enable sampled production passthrough (0.5% sample) and validate mapping between live examples and golden-label mapping tool
Introduce a controlled model variant with modified selection priors, run the harness, verify drop is detected and alert fires
Push an argument-shaping change in model (e.g., timestamp format) and assert linter catches field-level diffs and annotates schema mismatch reasons
Verify dashboard annotations include deploy id and link to PR; verify automated rollback flow in sandbox triggers and restores previous model variant
notes: Design decision: start with JSON Schema for argument validation to cover most structured tool args. If we encounter frequent semantic mismatches that JSON Schema cant express (e.g., external-state dependent validation), augment with lightweight custom validators per-tool.
Privacy: sampled production payloads must be scrubbed (PII redaction) before storage; coordinate with Security for retention policy
Spike: Arjun completed a 3-day spike demonstrating selection scoring logic and produced an RFC (link in Confluence) with scoring formula and thresholds
Ops runbook draft: add playbook entries for alert triage and manual rollback steps in Console when automated rollback declines
